raw.query: SELECT engine, n_images, round(avg(mean_ms)::numeric, 4) as avg_mean_ms, round(avg(ms_per_img)::numeric, 4) as avg_ms_per_img FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine IN ('sdpa', 'vllm') AND image_px = 448 AND n_images IN (1, 6, 8) GROUP BY engine, n_images ORDER BY engine, n_images;
raw.observed: sdpa stack: N=1 (avg 11.31 ms), N=6 (avg 43.38 ms, 7.23 ms/image, gain 1.56x), N=8 (avg 58.61 ms, 7.33 ms/image, gain 1.54x). vllm stack: N=1 (avg 8.00 ms), N=6 (avg 31.20 ms, 5.20 ms/image, gain 1.54x), N=8 (avg 42.16 ms, 5.27 ms/image, gain 1.52x).
raw.claimed: Measured end-to-end the realized gain is smaller and saturates by N≈6--8 on both execution stacks
raw.evidence: On both sdpa and vllm engines, per-image cost bottoms around N=6 (7.23 ms and 5.20 ms respectively) and N=8 (7.33 ms and 5.27 ms) with realized gains of ~1.54x-1.56x, which is smaller than the 1.65x composed graph gain.
